question_en: How's the weather outside today? And do you have any fun plans for the evening?
question_zh: 今天外面天气怎么样？你晚上有什么有趣的计划吗？

options.answer_en: It's actually quite chilly and windy today, so I'm wearing a heavy coat. As for the evening, I don't have anything big planned. I'm just planning to order some takeout, maybe some noodles, and binge-watch a new series on Netflix to unwind after a long day.
options.answer_zh: 今天外面其实挺冷的，风也很大，所以我穿了厚外套。至于晚上，没什么大计划。我打算点个外卖，可能吃碗面，然后在 Netflix 上追一部新剧，忙碌了一天之后放松一下。

notes.explanation_zh: big 放在不定代词 anything 后面修饰；planned 是过去分词，表示已经安排好的事情。整个短语表示“什么大计划”。
现在进行时可用来表达近期正在考虑或安排的打算，语气自然随意。
一口气连续刷很多集电视剧。例如：I binge-watched the whole season over the weekend.

options.answer_en: The weather is surprisingly nice! The sun is shining and it's not too hot. I'm actually meeting up with a couple of friends later. We're going to try that new hotpot place downtown, and hopefully, we can grab a bubble tea afterwards to catch up.
options.answer_zh: 天气出奇地好！阳光明媚，而且不太热。我晚些时候要见几个朋友。我们打算去市中心那家新开的火锅店尝尝，希望之后还能喝杯奶茶、聊聊近况。

notes.explanation_zh: 现在进行时表达已安排好的未来活动，尤其常用于约见朋友。
grab 在口语里有“顺便买/喝”的意思，轻松自然。
这里指叙旧、聊近况。例如：Let's catch up over coffee.

options.answer_en: It looks like it might rain later, so you might want to bring an umbrella. My evening is going to be pretty busy, unfortunately. I have to finish a report for work, and then I need to spend an hour practicing my English before going to bed.
options.answer_zh: 看起来晚些时候可能会下雨，你最好带把伞。不巧的是，我晚上会很忙。我得完成一份工作报告，然后睡前还要花一小时练习英语。

notes.explanation_zh: 表示“看起来好像……”，后面可直接接完整句子。
表达委婉的建议，相当于“你或许可以考虑……”。
表示“花时间做某事”，spend 后接动名词，例如 spend an hour practicing English。

question_en: What does your morning routine usually look like? Do you have time to eat breakfast before you head out?
question_zh: 你早上通常都怎么安排？出门前有时间吃早餐吗？

options.answer_en: I usually get up around seven and give myself a little time to wake up properly. I make myself a cup of coffee, put together a quick breakfast, and check my schedule for the day. I find that having a calm morning puts me in a much better mood, even when I have a lot on my plate.
options.answer_zh: 我通常七点左右起床，给自己一点时间彻底清醒过来。我会给自己泡杯咖啡，简单做份早餐，再看看当天的日程。我发现，早晨从容一点会让我心情好很多，即使有一大堆事情要忙也是如此。

notes.term: give myself a little time to...
notes.explanation_zh: 给自己留一点时间去做某事。give someone time to do something 是很自然的搭配。例如：Give yourself some time to adjust.（给自己一点时间适应。）
put together 在这里指用现有材料快速准备、拼凑出一份早餐，比 cook breakfast 更强调简单省事。

notes.term: have a lot on my plate
notes.explanation_zh: 字面意思是盘子里有很多东西，口语里表示手头事情很多、忙不过来。例如：I've got a lot on my plate this week.

options.answer_en: To be honest, my mornings are usually pretty chaotic. I tend to hit the snooze button a few times, so I end up rushing out the door. Most days, I just grab a sandwich on my way to work. I'm trying to get into the habit of going to bed earlier so I can stop feeling so rushed.
options.answer_zh: 说实话，我的早晨通常都有点手忙脚乱。我总会按好几次闹钟的贪睡键，结果最后只能匆匆忙忙地出门。大多数时候，我就在上班路上随便买个三明治。我正努力养成早点睡觉的习惯，这样早上就不会总觉得这么赶。

notes.explanation_zh: 表示“往往会……／通常容易……”，用来描述某种习惯或倾向。例如：I tend to stay up late.（我经常熬夜。）
表示“结果最后还是做了某事”，常常带有事情并非原计划的意味。end up 后接动词 -ing。例如：We ended up taking a taxi.

notes.term: get into the habit of doing something
notes.explanation_zh: 表示“逐渐养成做某事的习惯”。介词 of 后面接动名词，例如：get into the habit of reading every day.

options.answer_en: Since I work from home, I don't have to commute, which makes mornings a lot less stressful. I usually stretch for ten minutes, make some oatmeal, and ease into the day by checking my emails. Once I've figured out my priorities, I get straight to work. It's a routine that helps me stay focused without feeling overwhelmed.
options.answer_zh: 因为我在家办公，不用通勤，所以早上轻松多了。我通常先拉伸十分钟，煮点燕麦粥，然后从查看邮件开始，慢慢进入一天的状态。一旦理清了事情的轻重缓急，我就马上开始工作。这个习惯能让我保持专注，又不会觉得压力大到喘不过气。

notes.term: which makes mornings a lot less stressful
notes.explanation_zh: 这里的 which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面“不用通勤”这件事，说明它带来的结果。a lot 可加强比较级 less 的程度。
ease into 表示“慢慢进入、逐渐适应”，这里指不匆忙地开始一天。也可以说 ease into a new routine（慢慢适应新作息）。
表示“直接开始工作、马上投入工作”；straight to 强调不拖延、不绕弯。例如：After breakfast, I get straight to work.

question_en: How do you usually spend your weekends? Do you prefer making plans or just going with the flow?
question_zh: 你通常怎么度过周末？你更喜欢提前安排好，还是顺其自然？

options.answer_en: I usually keep my weekends pretty low-key. After a busy week, I like sleeping in a little, making myself a nice breakfast, and catching up on a show I've been meaning to watch. I try not to pack my schedule too tightly because I need some downtime to recharge.
options.answer_zh: 我的周末通常过得比较悠闲。忙了一周之后，我喜欢稍微睡个懒觉、给自己做顿好吃的早餐，再补看一部一直想看的剧。我尽量不把日程排得太满，因为我需要一些休息时间恢复精力。

notes.explanation_zh: 表示让某件事保持低调、简单、不折腾。keep my weekends low-key 就是周末安排得轻松一点。
表示补上之前没来得及做的事，例如 catch up on sleep（补觉）或 catch up on a show（补剧）。
现在完成进行时，表示一直有这个打算，却还没付诸行动。例如：I've been meaning to call you.（我一直想给你打电话。）
downtime 指休息、空闲时间；recharge 字面是充电，口语中指恢复精力。

options.answer_en: I prefer having at least one thing planned so I have something to look forward to. This weekend, I'm thinking of checking out a new café with a friend. We haven't seen each other in ages, so it'll be nice to catch up. Apart from that, I'll probably just go with the flow.
options.answer_zh: 我更喜欢至少提前安排一件事，这样就有个盼头。这个周末我打算和朋友去一家新咖啡馆看看。我们已经很久没见了，所以能聊聊近况应该挺开心的。除此之外，我大概就随性安排了。

notes.term: have something to look forward to
notes.explanation_zh: 表示有值得期待的事情。look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。
check out 在口语中表示去看看、体验一下某个地方，不是“检查”或“结账”的意思。

notes.term: haven't seen each other in ages
notes.explanation_zh: 现在完成时描述从过去延续到现在的未见面状态；in ages 是口语夸张说法，表示很久。
表示顺其自然、不做太多计划，常用于描述周末或旅行安排。

options.answer_en: I like to strike a balance between getting things done and taking it easy. On Saturday mornings, I usually spend a couple of hours studying or working on a personal project. Once that's out of the way, I can enjoy the rest of the weekend without feeling guilty about unfinished tasks.
options.answer_zh: 我喜欢在完成任务和放松之间找到平衡。周六早上，我通常会花几个小时学习或做自己的项目。等这些事处理完，我就可以安心享受剩下的周末，而不用因为任务没完成而有负担。

notes.term: strike a balance between A and B
notes.explanation_zh: 表示在 A 和 B 之间取得平衡。between 后的两个部分通常采用平行结构，例如 getting things done 和 taking it easy。
表示花时间做某事，spend 后接时间，doing 表示具体活动，例如 spend two hours studying。

notes.term: once that's out of the way
notes.explanation_zh: once 引导时间状语从句，表示“一旦”；out of the way 指某件需要处理的事情已经完成、不再碍事。
without 是介词，后接动名词 feeling；feel guilty about 表示因为某事感到内疚。
